paragraphs.text:
Without warning, Charlie raises her rifle and trains it on you. 
“You  do  not  listen! Your  kind  never  listens!  Die,  if  you  must.  I 
will take no part of it.” She runs to the canoe, throws in some 
supplies, and shoves off.

Record the keyword BAREFOOT. To track Bernard’s killers, go to 
87. To give up and try to take your remaining charges out of this 
evergreen wasteland on foot, go to 324.
